evidenceBoundaries: Input JSON contains only ordinary held buttons; replay header and first two encoded blocks are byte-identical to the UI template. No actor/weapon START is stored in replay inputs.

Only combat_replay_input has an original frame field. Ordinary events use exactSameTickReplayRead only when replayReadTick equals event tick and the expected consumer matches; otherwise they are lastSnapshot or noReplaySnapshot.
Damage events have no child-owner pointer. Their ordered trial and same enemy identity are retained; no individual damage is assigned to a specific child solely from HUD or button timing.
The second weapon0 START at frame600 is real, but its missing120-damage hit is not invented; total second-trial damage is540, not660.
Redeployment can momentarily raise TAMA to10. Later aggregate count reductions are recorded without claiming a permanent six-object bound or proving all children were reclaimed.
STOP15/20s is root visual UI evidence, not native menu READY. The later read-only tool snapshot observed inactive replay frame1200 with TAMA4/SCRIPT0, not complete object cleanup.
RESET/recovery between actions prevents accepting these routes as a true combo. No unrelated HUD883HIT, old-PAC coverage, cancellation/interruption or other skills are accepted.
Only the explicit private case Replay001/002/004 files were read to verify hashes and block boundaries; no replay/dat binary or original user Save content is copied or changed.
